svg.text: How Claude and its agents run a day, spec first
one day spec at a time
the spec in its own PR
reads the diff, runs every check
first and last day of a phase
each starts cold, with its own brief:
the session that writes the code
is not the only one checking it
the working order and each agent's brief
every merge republishes the dashboard; the session then runs spec-drift.py for the next step
2 audit: plan-auditor on a phase's first
3 a spec-change PR fixes what they found
a phase's last day: plan-auditor, then stop
A test passes before and after the change.
Has it ever been seen to fail?
2. run it, note what it said
verify + checkstyle; read reports, not exit codes
Stop and ask, do not patch
a Day 1–4 contract test needs an edit
an applied migration needs an edit
a criterion cannot be met as written
record the departure; never deviate silently
after every PR: stop, wait for 'merged'
after a phase ends, nothing starts
From CLAUDE.md and docs/workflow.md. The auditors' findings are advice; what becomes a PR is the maintainer's call.
